title: The Secret Reason Horses Let Us Ride Them
summary: CGP Grey explains why horses could be ridden and why other animals like zebras and bears were never domesticated for war or riding. It is a follow-up on the topic of animal domestication.
why: HN recommends it as a classic on why some animals are suited to farming and domestication and others are not.

quote.text: CGP Grey has a great video [0] that goes into why some animals are better to farm/breed/eat than others.
